translation.name: Lagano da Isambi da Mndewa na Mkombola Wetu Yesu Kilisto

content: Umwaka Mulungu kalonga na wahenga zetu mianza bwando na mnzila bwando kubitila wahokozi,
ila muna gamazua gano ga kimambukizo kalonga na tweye kubitila Mwanage ayo ulumwengu ulumbigwe kubitila heyo, na yasaguligwe kuvihala vinhu vose.

Heyo iyo unang'hazi wa yenzi ya Mulungu na kalinga kabisa na vija viyali, yovitenda vinhu vose vigendelele kukala kubitila mbuli zake zili na mhiko. Viyamambukize kuvisegeza vilozo, kakala hanhu ha hishima kumkono wa ukulume wa Mulungu Mkulu.
Mwana wa Mulungu kawa mkulu ng'hani kubanza wasenga wose wa Mulungu wa kuulanga, kamba vidili twaga Mulungu diyamgwelele vidili kulu ng'hani kubanza matwaga gao.
Kwavija Mulungu hamulongele msenga wake yoyose wa kuulanga,
Ama Mulungu hamulongele msenga wake yoyose wa kuulanga kamba,
Ila viyamgalile chaudele wake muulumwengu, kalonga,

content.text: “Wasenga zangu wose wa kuulanga wamtambikile heyo.”

content: Ila mmbuli ya wasenga zake wa kuulanga, Mulungu kalonga,

content.text: “Mulungu kowatuma wasenga zake wa kuulanga kamba beho,

content: Ila mmbuli ya Mwana, Mulungu kalonga,

content.text: “Undewa wako, gweye Mulungu, wokala milongo yose!
Gweye konogelwa na ganogile na kugehila gehile.
Avo Mulungu, Mulungu wako, kakusagula gweye uwe uchana ya wayago,
na kuulumba ulanga na makono gako mwenyego.
Ila gweye kowa vivo mazua gose,
na ugima wako wowa bule nziga.”

content: Mulungu hamulongele msenga wake yoyose wa kuulanga mbuli zino,

content.text: kamba kigoda cha kwikila magulu gako.”

content: Avo wasenga wa Mulungu wa kuulanga iwo walihi? Hewo iwo loho womsang'hanikila Mulungu na watumigwa na heyo kuwataza awo wondawabokele ukombola.
